nom: Estée Lauder Mini DayWear Advanced Multi-Protection Anti-Oxidant 24H Moisturizer Crème SPF 15

avis.texte: I've been using this moisturizer for several years and remain very pleased with it.

I love this moisturizer. I am in my forties and it took me YEARS of trying every product out there to finally settle on the daywear moisturizer. It is light, smells great, and helps my skin more than any other product. I highly recommend it.
Great feel, makes your skin look bright and supple. worked well under my eyes.
I wear this every day. It is light and creamy and absorbs smoothly. That is contains SPF is a plus.

avis.titre: You Is Smarth, You Is Kind, You Is Important
avis.texte: My firts purchases! Love skin care and make up, looking to buying more, I want the cosmetic bags for my collection!!! LOVE IT 💕

Great moisture but light and soaks in. Love that it has sunscreen and doesn't cause me to break out. Great scent as well. Have been using it for many many years. I just wish they would have a refill available for this after all these years - that's kind of selfish of wasteful of Estee Lauder.

I have used Estée Lauder for years I have tried other products but end up going back to Estée Lauder. In fact, my dermatologist told me to stick with what I'm doing because my skin looks great for my age.
Have been using this product for years - it is the best - you definitely get are getting a great product!

I always get compliments on my skin. Dewey and few wrinkles! I have used Estee Lauder Day Wear for 25 years and the compliments keep coming! I pair with Estee Lauder primers, foundations, and powders/bronzers for a moisturized and glowing look! I've tried all the others- nothing comes close. Stock up and save when deals come into esteelauder.com or your favorite department store. Free gifts too!

avis.titre: Love the light fragrance of this cream
avis.texte: Love this moisturizer so much. The light fragrance is fantastic! (The fragrance does not linger on your skin, but it smells so good when you open the container!) Very nice moisturizer. Received a sample of this with a GWP and love it so much.

I love this moisturizer and use it every morning now. I love the way it makes my face feels and looks, smooth and refreshed. I can tell a difference when I forget to put it on. I love the light scent and that it has SPF in it. I use it after toner and serum, and before my makeup and it is perfect.
Best day cream for anti-aging properties its good for combination to normal skin its work great under makeup really very long lasting no mory dry patches

This product is a nice upgrade from what I've been using. It goes on smooth and my skin stays hydrated. I have combination skin and this did not give me an oily appearance like some other products. It has a nice clean, non-floral scent. My makeup stayed on well on top of the moisturizer. I will purchase again.

This DayWear moisturizer is my holy grail for daytime! I've tried so many daytime moisturizers and most of them end up pilling under my makeup, but this one doesn't at all. It keeps my skin super hydrated and leaves the most beautiful dewy glow. My makeup sits perfectly on top of it, and my skin looks fresh all day. I'm obsessed!

avis.titre: Will use it from now on
avis.texte: New to me but I've used moisturizers forever, this one is especially nice with a pleasant cucumber fragrance. Love under makeup or as a night moisturizer

I recently tried Estée Lauder The Hydrating Routine and genuinely loved this line. I used the products as part of my morning and nighttime routine, and my skin felt noticeably softer and more hydrated. The moisturizer was my favorite—it felt buttery, creamy, and lightweight while still being very hydrating without feeling oily. The scent reminded me of a nostalgic cucumber melon fragrance, which I absolutely loved. I honestly wish they made a full body version of it. The other products in the routine were great as well, especially the night serum, night cream, and eye cream. My skin felt smooth, nourished, and refreshed after using them consistently.I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.
This face cream is the best ever for any skin. It is good to travel with in your carry on.
I would recommend this product a million times, the was it leaves my skin soft and glowing. Its definitely worth the price. Must try it with the night time repair and under eye treatment.

Good moisturizer with a light cucumber scent. The scent is not super strong which is appreciated but smells very fresh and refreshing. Moisturizer is on the lighter side so maybe not the best choice if you have super dry skin but works very well as a day to day moisturizer. Left skin feeling soft. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I've been applying this moisturizer each morning before putting on my makeup, and it's quickly become a standout in my routine. It creates a smooth, hydrated base that makes my foundation apply flawlessly and stay looking fresh throughout the day—no dryness, no settling into fine lines or creases. The texture is silky and lightweight, absorbing quickly and leaving my skin with a soft, youthful glow. I also really appreciate the built‑in SPF 15. I often forget sunscreen, so having that protection included makes my routine easier while still supporting my long‑term anti‑aging goals. The scent is light and fresh, not overpowering, and the overall feel of the crème is luxurious without being heavy. My skin stays hydrated all day, which makes a noticeable difference in how my makeup wears. *I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: The Best Moisturizer Fo Dry Skin
avis.texte: I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. I have dry skin and Estee Lauder 24 hr multi-protection moisturizer cream has made my skin feel hydrating. I have been using this product for 3 weeks now and I am impressed. I apply mornings, I do not feel like I need to re apply same day as I already feel my face hydrated enough. My skin looks super nice and apply this product makes my skin feel amazing. This moisturizer has 24 hour multi-protections Broad Spectrum SPF 15 as well, which adds protection to your skin from sun. The texture of the moisture is perfect combination and it is not watery or too thick feeling. I also enjoyed the scent which is cucumber scent. Everything was perfect about this product. I would def use it again and recommend without hesitation.
Very moisturizing but it does have a very strong, citrus/fresh scent. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This is hands-down one of the best daily moisturizers I've used. It's definitely a fav of mine. I use this one pretty much every morning because of the spf. I'm a huge fan of the watermelon-like scent, it's super refreshing! It's really great all around, especially if you get a lot of sun where you live. I would 100% recommend this to any of my family or friends! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This moisturizer is a lifesaver for my combination skin, perfectly balancing my dry patches and oily T-zone. I use it every morning; the whipped texture feels luxurious and sinks in instantly without any grease. The crisp cucumber scent is so refreshing—like a morning spa treatment. It provides lasting hydration that keeps my skin "bouncy" all day and acts as a smooth base that makes my makeup look flawless. The SPF 15 is a great added bonus for daily protection. It's a high-performance essential that leaves my skin bright and clear. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

Absolutely am obsessed with this spf/moisturizer combo!!! It's sure gentle on my skin and is packed with amazing ingredient; I've noticed after finishing the cream my skin is def brighter!! I love the light fragrance of this cream too! I wear it every morning. I recieved this product free from Estée Lauder for testing and reviewing purposes

This moisturizer is very nourishing but still suitable for a day cream, so it can be worn under makeup. It also makes you look very glowy, which I know some people might not be a fan of but I personally love it. I have skin that's on the dryer side around this time of year so this moisturizer would work for you if you have skin like mine. There is a scent, though. I am not particularly sensitive to scents so I don't mind it and it didn't irritate my skin either, but keep that in mind if you care about scents. Overall a great day moisturizer for people with dryer skin, who like glowy looks, and do not care about scents. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

The texture is luxurious but sinks in immediately. My skin feels soft, protected, and smells amazing. I love that it includes antioxidants to fight off environmental stress. I use tretinoin at night and this moisturizer keeps my skin peel-free. I received the Estée Lauder DayWear Multi-Protection Creme and I'm so glad I did!

I use this face cream each morning as it contains SPF. At first, it applies with a white cast. Over about a minute, the cream absorbs into the skin and is translucent. I really love the dewy glow that this cream brings to my face; it also provides long lasting hydration. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

The 24 hour wear does not feel as heavy to me as the 72 hour version, and the SPF element in the 24 hour wear did not bother my sensitive skin like the 72 hour did. However I have a harder time getting Estee Lauder products to absorb into my skin than other brands of moisturizer. Even when using a small amount it feels greasy on my face, so day wear is definitely the only option for me with removal before bed. Otherwise I can see the moisturizer transfer to my pillowcase at night. I think I'll stick to other brands personally. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

As a guy who prefers a simple skincare routine, I approached the Estée Lauder DayWear Moisturizer Multi-Protection Anti-Oxidant 24H-Moisture Creme SPF 15 with practical expectations. I want something that works, feels comfortable, and fits easily into my morning routine. After regular use, this moisturizer has proven to be a dependable daily option. The texture is one of its biggest strengths. It is lightweight, smooth, and easy to apply, absorbing quickly without leaving a greasy or shiny finish. My skin feels hydrated right away, but still natural and breathable. It is the kind of product you can apply and forget about, which is ideal for busy mornings. The scent is clean and subtle. It is noticeable at first but fades fast, making it easy to wear alongside cologne or in professional settings without being distracting. Once absorbed, it leaves no lingering fragrance. Hydration is consistent throughout the day. My skin usually starts to feel tight by midday, especially indoors, but DayWear keeps it feeling balanced and comfortable. My face looks healthier and smoother without feeling oily or heavy. I rarely feel the need to reapply. The SPF 15 is a useful bonus. While it is not enough for long hours in direct sun, it offers everyday protection and reduces the need for an extra step. The antioxidant focus also adds confidence when dealing with environmental stress. It also works well after shaving. It soothes the skin, reduces dryness, and does not sting or irritate. I receiv

This moisturizing was great for day and soaked into the skin beautifully. This product wasn't too heavy and had a melon scent to it. I wish it came in a pump for more convenience but that's the only downfall. The moisterizer let a healthy glow to my skin and left it soft. "I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes. I love this moisturizer. It feels genuinely luxurious — super velvety on the skin and just really nice to wear. It's one of those products that actually makes your skincare routine feel like an experience. I use it as my daily moisturizer. It does have SPF 15, which isn't enough for me on its own, so I always add more SPF on top, but I still like that it has some built in. It never feels heavy or weird under sunscreen. The texture is perfect for colder months. It's thick and very moisturizing, but not greasy at all, and it absorbs quickly. My skin feels soft and comfortable right away, not slick or shiny. I also really like the scent. It's subtle but elevated, and it just adds to that "luxury" feeling. Overall, this is one of those dependable, feel-good products I keep reaching for, especially in winter.

Let me start by saying I am a long time lover of Estée Lauder! Their products never fail to make my skin look and feel beautiful. I have tried the 72 hour daywear and 24 hour daywear and there are some notable differences. This moisturizer is rich with a subtle scent! My skin is supple and smooth after applying this moisturizer. It's the perfect base for makeup and your night routine. This moisturizer keeps my skin feeling refreshed throughout the day without leaving a greasy feel! If I had to decide between the 24 or the 72 hour I would go with the 24 hour simply for the feel but that is a personal preference! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I use this moisturizer everyday as my morning moisturizer because it has spf in it. It has a lightweight feel and doesn't leave me greasy like some other spfs do. I love a scented moisturizer especially when it's a spa like scent. I've already recommended this to my sister & would suggest it to friends! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I had mixed feelings about this moisture cream, as I found both things that I liked and things a didn't like at all. The things I liked: a little goes a long way, great value to product amount, no skin irritation, and leaves skin feeling soft (but, see below). Now, the things I didn't care for: the smell was too strong like early 2000's cucumber melon spray that lingers on the skin, and it was also sticky/tacky feeling for the first 5 or so minutes after using it. Overall, the product did what it was supposed to, but it wouldn't be my go to primarily due to the scent. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

The Estée Lauder DayWear Multi-Protection Anti-Oxidant 24H-Moisture Creme SPF 15 is great for everyday wear. The creme is incredibly nourishing without feeling heavy, providing great hydration during the dry winter month when mynskin definitely needs extra love. It looks great under makeup, preventing foundation from clinging to dry patches or pilling. I would definitely be repurchasing this when I run out of it. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. I like that this creme is thick and it is great for my dry skin especially during these cold rainy days when my face needs that extra moisture. As soon as as you open the jar you get that cucumber scent which I don't mind but it is a bit strong. I use this every day and night paired with the estee lauder serum and it has worked well for my skin. I just wish the spf would have been a bit higher on this one.

I used the Estee Lauder DayWear Multi-Protection 24H Moisture Crème every morning daily for a month and I can say that it is a great addition to my skincare routine. It provides long lasting hydration all day long and it wears well under the light makeup I use. It has a very light scent that is not overpowering. It did not make my face feel greasy, oily or irritate my skin. Even with SPF I still do apply additional sunscreen. I think this is a great product. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This moisturizer has been great to use. My favorite part is the green tone it has. It completely tones down my redness throughout the day (I have rosacea) and looks great/ protects from the sun. I highly recommend it for people with redness. "I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

I have been using this moisturizer for the past month. I recently started using a prescription strength retinol that dries out the skin a lot. Combine that with the cold winter weather, my skin really needed a little of moisture. This cream is thick, moisturizing, and absorbs well without leaving the skin greasy or oily. I find that my skin is moisturized throughout the day and it helps with dry patches from the retinol. It contains SPF 15 which is better than nothing and find for the winery months where the UV index is below 2. I do not notice much of a scent (maybe a light cucumber smell) which is good for those who prefer unscented products. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes, but I would purchase again with my own money.

I really liked this product. It has a really wonderful scent and makes you feel like you're literally in a spa. It also left my skin feeling so hydrated and nourished and I really enjoyed using this on myself. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

Overall, I do really enjoy the consistency of this face cream. It's very thick and moisturizing which is perfect for this cold, dry weather. However, I have very sensitive skin, and this moisturizer does seem to slightly irritate it. It has a very strong scent, so perhaps it's the perfumes. I stick to using it on my forehead and neck which seems to work for my skin. "I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."
Absorbs beautifully into the skin and leaves no white cast. Sits well under makeup and definitely a great moisturizer. Nice light cucumber scent as well

I have combination skin, so in the summer I go pretty light on daytime hydration and typically reach for an essence and hydrating skincare. But as we get into the drier winter months, I have really enjoyed wearing this Day Cream. It is luxe and hydrating on the skin, absorbing nicely without feeling heavy at all. I am not typically a fan of scented products but I really love this one. It's light, fresh and feels like a spa day. There's a minimal amount of SPF, which doesn't hurt but shouldn't be relied on for full coverage. My skin feels softer and more hydrated when I use this and best of all, my makeup looks great too – no added shine at all. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

If you've been looking to cut down on your skincare routine, this moisturizer is a great pick—a cream and sunscreen in one! The texture is thick and would be amazing for those with normal to dry skin. I have oily skin, so it sits a bit thick on my face if I just slab it on, but going with a thin layer helps! Just leave it to dry before makeup and it sets well. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This moisturizer checks a lot of boxes for me as a daytime option. I have always enjoyed the brand, and this formula feels thoughtfully made. The hydration is long lasting without crossing into heavy territory, which is something I really value in a morning creme. The added SPF is a big plus, though I personally tend to prefer a higher level of sun protection for Florida days. What stands out most is how quickly it absorbs while still keeping my skin comfortable and soft all day. My makeup layers well over it, and it helps create a fresh looking base rather than that slippery SPF feel some products leave behind. It feels lightweight, not greasy, and does not interfere with the rest of my routine. The jar size is generous, and only a small amount is needed each time. I also appreciate that the formula feels gentle and free from strong fragrance. My skin looks smooth and glowy, and overall this has been a very pleasant addition to my daytime routine. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I love Estee Lauder's DayWear Creme! I use it every morning and love that it has SPF. The container is super elegant and the moisturizer smells nice and fresh. I love the initial cool feeling on my skin and the lasting hydration. My face feels softer and I look forward to using it each morning. I would definitely recommend! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I really love this moisturizer. The scent is light and refreshing and smells like a blend of florals and green tea. It feels clean and calming without being greasy. The packaging is beautiful and looks luxurious, and I really like the green hue of the cream itself. What I liked the most was the consistency. It looks a bit thick in the jar, but once applied it goes on effortlessly and a little goes a long way. It absorbs smoothly into the skin and worked really well under my foundation. Highly recommended! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I am in awe with this crème. Not only does it hydrate the skin, but it protects it from the sun all at the same time. From the first time I applied it I was able to see my skin more plump and hydrated compared to many other high end brands I've previously tried. My personal opinion is that it works best when used once in the morning daily because it prepares the skin for the sun rays and other drying factors through the day. Long story short I definitely recommend this product!!!! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes

I love everything Estée Lauder but I especially love their moisturizer. I will say that you need to like cucumber scent or you will not like this cream. I absolutely love the scent, it smells so fresh and clean and feel so smooth on the skin. The cream is not too thick and absorbes well into my skin. I have sensitive skin and can be acne prone and have personally never had a problem. It goes on well under my makeup and gives a glowy finish I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Alright so far for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have sensitive combination type skin and have been using this moisturizer for the past 30ish days. I really like the consistency; it is gel-like, thick, and has a cool feel to it. The moisturizer hasn't been irritating my skin, and I think it has been reducing my regular redness/sensitivity a bit but it may be too soon to tell. Overall seems decent and worth a try if you're looking for a nice thick moisturizer for sensitive skin. I think I'll reach for this when my skin is especially dry in the winter. Also bonus points for having SPF! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Loved the texture and the scent!
avis.texte: I've been using this as my daytime moisturizer for a couple of weeks and have been very happy with it! It absorbs well and provides the right level of moisture without being too heavy. It does well under my regular sunscreen and makeup, too- I haven't noticed any pilling. There is a light, pleasant scent that reminds me of cucumbers. I haven't liked most of the vitamin C products that I've tried before but this one hasn't caused any irritation. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Like the Product, Not the Price
avis.texte: I really like this moisturizer, but not the price. It's not overly scented which is nice and the packaging is simple and well-made. It was not too greasy or heavy for my combination skin, even in the more oily areas. The spf is nice to have for the winter and it's not so greasy that I can't add sunscreen on top in the summer. I enjoyed this product a lot but would not rebuy for myself, if I got it again as a gift I'd enjoy it tho! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

Estee Lauder Daywear Moisturizer Multi-Protection Anti-Oxidant 24H - Moisture Cream with SPF 15 is one of the best products I have tried and I am now in love with it. The texture of it is so rich, smooth and creamy and it smells so good. It keeps my face produced and moisturized all day long and I definitely recommend this product it's a must-have. "I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes."

This moisturizer with SPF has become a staple in my daily skincare routine. It feels lightweight and non-greasy, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any white cast, which makes it perfect for everyday use. The hydration lasts all day and keeps my skin feeling soft, smooth, and well-nourished without clogging pores. The added SPF is a big plus, offering reliable sun protection without the need to layer an extra sunscreen. It sits well under makeup and doesn't pill, making it ideal for both morning routines and busy days. I also appreciate that it doesn't irritate sensitive skin and works well in both humid and dry weather. Overall, it's a great all-in-one product that combines moisturization and sun protection effortlessly. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a simple, effective daily moisturizer with SPF.

I found the cream to have a light green color and a very subtle cucumber scent. It felt very hydrating on the skin, leaving only a slight residue that wasn't heavy or greasy. The product comes in a beautiful bottle with a shiny gold lid, giving it an elevated, luxe look. It's also great for daytime use since it includes SPF protection. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I really like how this moisturizer feels — it's lightweight but still keeps my skin hydrated all day. It goes on smoothly, works great under makeup, and I love that it has SPF and antioxidants built in for everyday protection. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes
Love this day cream! Isn't greasy, super moisturizing. Would definitely recommend. So happy with the results. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This DayWear cream from Estée Lauder has been a savior for my skin this winter! This cold dry weather has sucked all the moisture out of my skin but this lightweight cream packs a punch in hydration! My skin looks and feels plumper and dewier and wears extremely well under my foundation. As an added bonus this has spf15 so I can moisturize and protect my skin all in one step. I also love the light cucumber smell of this product, it smells very spa-like. Highly recommend! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes

This is a great product, especially for those that have acne prone skin, even more so for those who are in their teens and early/mid twenties. Layers very well under makeup, and smoothes and brightens the skin. As a bonus feature, I love that I do not have to wear a separate sunscreen as the DayWear already protects against sun damage with Broad Spectrum UVA/UVB SPF 15. I especially like this moisturizer for more humid climates (like when on a beach vacation) because it also helps to control shine/oil on the skin. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I think this is a wonderful daytime moisturizer during the winter or whenever you aren't going to be outside much since there is a small amount of SPF. I would not recommend in the summer when you need at least SPF 30. There was a light scent but not too much. It sank in pretty well but did leave my skin a touch wet/oily feeling which is fine with me during the winter when my skin is dry. I wore it under makeup and it was okay, although my skin was pretty glowy after applying so it acted like a glowy primer. It didn't amaze me but was still great! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This product smells amazing if you like cucumber scents! I love that it's very moisturizing and has SPF so I can combine them all in one step in the morning. It's great for my oily/combo skin, especially in the winter. Might be too thick for humid summers in the Southeast. Highly recommend! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This moisturizer has become a staple in my routine. It's incredibly lightweight but still deeply hydrating, which can be hard to find, especially for combination skin. It sinks in quickly without feeling greasy and leaves my skin feeling calm, smooth, and well-balanced throughout the day. I love how soothing it is, and the added antioxidant protection and SPF 15 make it an easy, no-brainer for daily use. My skin feels refreshed and comfortable, not weighed down or shiny. If you have combination skin and want something that hydrates without overwhelming your face, this is a great option. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I have dry skin and great as a daily moisturizer + light sun protection with added antioxidant benefits, especially if you mostly stay indoors or want a base for makeup. If you're going out in strong sun, add a stronger sunscreen on top

I love this moisturizer! It's become my new favorite morning moisturizer. It's thick and creamy but not too heavy on my skin. It works so well under makeup. It leaves a slightly tacky base that helps my foundation grip and last longer without any pilling. Plus the SPF is a nice bonus for everyday wear. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

This is a very thick, moisturizing day cream. I liked it for the day, but I actually LOVE it for night. It am not sure if it is the SPF or what, but my skin takes a long time to absorb it, but once it does, my skin feels AMAZING! It does have a scent, it is very fresh, and I think cucumber-y. I put it on after I brush my teeth and wash my face. Part of my routine after that is taking care of my dogs, setting out the next day's outfit for work, and getting my coffee supplies ready…..this gives it plenty of time to absorb. It's so nice to wake up with such soft, smooth skin! I have had major dryness issues lately, which are new for me. I appreciate that this one is not watery or absorbs instantly then my skin feels dry again soon. This truly does last all day. Love it! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I was hesitant to try this, but so glad I did! It provides excellent moisture and SPF for my oily/dry skin in the winter months of MN. It is super thick and has great coverage. It does take a few minutes to dry/set before you're able to apply makeup. Would definitely recommend to anyone with combo skin looking for a great moisturizer with SPF! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I really like this moisturizer. I tend to lean towards dry skin and this makes my face feel hydrated. It goes on very nice and dries pretty quickly. It doesn't make my face feel greasy and my makeup applies just fine over it. I also really like that it contains spf although I still apply a stronger spf afterwards. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

Especially during the cooler months, I am constantly dealing with dry skin. This crème has been the perfect addition to my morning routine! It's lightweight and absorbs nicely, soothing my skin and providing much needed moisture. My only complaint is that I wish the scent was just a little milder. It's not awful, but it's enough to make me skip this product if I'm already battling a headache. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I love this daytime moisturizer so much, I have been tempted to use it during my nighttime routine! The level of moisture this gives is so so nice and comforting. My skin quickly dries out when we switch to indoor heating and this formula has been the perfect preventative option. The subtle scent of cucumber makes the experience even more luxurious. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This daily lotion with SPF will become a new staple in my morning skincare routine! I wear SPF daily as the final step of my morning routine, and I especially love when I find a high-quality lotion that keeps my very dry skin moisturized while protecting me from the sun. This lotion's light scent didn't bother me or my skin and the rich texture kept my skin hydrated. My make up did not pill, and I did not look greasy by the end of the day. This is an excellent daily moisturizer + sunscreen that I will keep coming back to when it is time to repurchase! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This moisturizer is light yet hydrating. The creme absorbed into my skin easily without being greasy. I used the moisturizer both morning and night. The scent was clean yet not overpowering. I liked that this has SPF 15, which is nice, but wish it was a higher SPF. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

As someone who isn't great about remembering face moisturizer and SPF, I really enjoyed using this DayWear Multi-Protection Anti-Oxidant 24H Moisture Creme SPF 15 because it's an all-in-one product. It's easy to implement into my daily routine, works well as an on-the-go daily moisturizer, and doesn't feel greasy on my skin.I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Moderate moisture, chem spf may irritate
avis.texte: I used this SPF Moisturizer in the mornings and would layer it under a higher SPF mineral sunscreen if I was going to be exposed to UV. It has luxurious packaging and a fresh scent, with a medium amount of moisturization; I would recommend an extra moisturizing product under it for other folks with dry skin. I ended up not being able to moisturize around my eyes with it as it would make them burn and tear, which after some research I learned may have been from the chemical sunscreen. It leaves a shine on your skin and blends much better under makeup than mineral sunscreens. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

The smell is fantastic and works really well with my skin. The cream is nice and moisturizing and keeps skin feeling protected from the sun. Really enjoy it and feels nice and airy. "I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

avis.titre: A Smooth, Protective Base for Everyday Wear
avis.texte: This moisturizer serves as a dependable start to my morning skincare. Its lightweight cream texture melts into skin without heaviness or shine, leaving a soft, smooth finish that works well under foundation or worn alone. The inclusion of SPF 15 makes it practical for daily protection, and the clean, cucumber-like scent feels refreshing. I found it kept my skin comfortably hydrated through a regular day, though on very dry days I layered a richer serum underneath. For those with normal to combination skin looking for a fuss-free, antioxidant-rich moisturizer with sun protection, this is a reliable pick. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder via Topbox Circle for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Light on the Skin, Not Short Lived
avis.texte: This surprised me in a good way right from the first application. The consistency is thick, but it spreads easily and feels light once it is on. The texture is silky, not greasy, and it settles into the skin instead of sitting there. There is a soft floral scent that feels classic and calm, nothing loud. I can see the hydration right after applying, and my skin stays hydrated throughout the day instead of drying out by midday. It just makes my skin look smoother and more rested. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Perfect for the girlies with sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin that will breakout at the wrong product easily. I have been unable to find a moisturizer, let alone a sunscreen that doesn't make me regret my choice until now! I was unsure about estee lauder as a younger woman with a darker skintone but, I was so wrong! I have been using this for a few months now and my skin looks dewy, moisturized, some of my dark spots have completely faded and my skin looks alive and even. The quality of the product is very much reflected in the price and it is absolutely worth it, will be restocking! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. And I would not have tried it if it wasn't for the free testing - sincerely I do not sugar coat my reviews, this product is actually really good.

I struggle because I quite like this formula but the initial scent is way overbearing for me. It moisturizes well and the scent fades— I wore it both day and night. I just wish we could get past whatever is making it smell like that. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. I have been using this as my morning moisturizer for the last two weeks. It's fantastic for my normal, slightly dehydrated skin. It's creamy and hydrating but not greasy. I appreciate the spf 15, but I always layer a stronger spf over if I plan on being outdoors. The cucumber scent is very pleasant, although it is a bit stronger than I would like in a face product.

I think this is a perfect daytime moisturizer for anyone with dry skin, especially if you live in a cold and / or dry environment, or for harsher winter conditions! I love how rich and thick this moisturizer is and that it features SPF 15 for a bit of sun protection as well. I live in Florida currently and find this product to be a little heavy for the amount of humidity here, but I can tell it will be ideal for using when traveling to colder climates this winter! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I've been using the Estée Lauder DayWear Moisturizer and honestly, it's one of those products that quietly slips into your routine and suddenly you can't imagine skipping it. The texture is that perfect in-between — not too heavy, not too gel-like — just a smooth, refreshing cream that sinks in without leaving a greasy finish. It gives my skin this soft, healthy glow right away, and the hydration genuinely lasts throughout the day. What I love the most is the anti-oxidant protection and the fact that it has SPF 15, so it feels like a little safety net for my skin on days I'm running around and not doing a full sunscreen moment. The scent is light and fresh, very "clean girl morning," and it layers well under makeup without pilling.

Estée Lauder DayWear is a beautiful everyday moisturizer. It's lightweight, absorbs fast, and keeps my skin feeling hydrated all day without being greasy. I like that it has SPF 15 and antioxidants for a little extra daily protection. My skin feels soft, fresh, and smooth, and it layers really well under makeup. Overall it's an easy, reliable go-to for great daytime hydration. "I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."
It works great with hydrating my skin, plus it has SPF 15 which protects my skin from sun for daily use. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: I love this DayWear SPF 15 24Hr Cream
avis.texte: I used the 24hr spf15 daywear cream day and night, and I love it! The texture is dreamy and smooth, the color is a soft teal in the container but applies with quick absorption and no cast. In my regular environment this is perfect for once or twice daily application. I did take it on a vacation to a drier climate and with my normal but dry leaning skin I would've benefitted from bringing the 72hr version instead, but that's my own fault! I have already recommended both versions to a friend, and think that for most people and environments that this is the perfect face cream (: disclaimer: I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. (It is truly SO good tho, dont let the disclaimer dissuade you!!)

After two weeks of use, this moisturizer left me with mostly positive impressions. Although it is thicker than the gel creams I usually prefer, it still feels lightweight and comfortable on the skin. Despite having oily skin, it never felt greasy and layered well under sunscreen and makeup. I also enjoyed the subtle honeydew melon scent and the added SPF. However, I did experience breakouts during the first few uses before my skin adjusted, which may be a concern for acne-prone skin. The SPF 15 is also too low to rely on alone, so a separate sunscreen is still needed. Overall, it works well as a lightweight daily moisturizer, but not as an all-in-one daytime product. this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

As someone who has to suffer through the cold winter of the northeast, my skin struggles with lack of hydration and dullness. This moisturizer solved both problems, without causing any breakouts. It's not greasy which makes it just as easy to wear under makeup as it is on its own. It does have a light fragrance, which doesn't bother me at all. Highly recommend during those seasons when you need an extra boost of moisture! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. I really enjoyed using this moisturizer with SPF in the morning. It kept my skin feeling soft and moisturized throughout the day, and the SPF protection was a plus!

I am pretty picky when it comes to an SPF, so I am always surprised when a product is decent. I have dry/normal skin that can also lean sensitive. This moisturizer states it is for normal/combination skin but I thought it was a good moisturizer for the last step in my skin care routine (following other hydrating products). I found it absorbed fairly well for an SPF, and I don't feel greasy the rest of the day. Unfortunately, it is scented so not really sensitive-skin friendly. Though I will say, the scent is really light and pleasant, almost a cucumber-aloe scent. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I was super bummed about this because I was SO excited to use it and honestly, it does the job. Immediate hydration to my face. I used after my shower. It smells great, the color of the crème is a beautiful mint green. I love that it has SPF in it as well. It just made me break out like crazy, tried to push through the break out and it wasn't improving, so it just wasn't a good fit for MY skin. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. I enjoyed using this product for many reasons. I am very picky when it comes to my skincare because Im a combo/oily skinned girly, that wears a fully face of makeup regularly. I do have some acne and at 37 Im staring to see signs of aging. So I choose my skincare VERY meticulously and I struggle with finding moisturizers that hydrate but dont leave me feeling greasy, but that can also be worn under my makeup without it separating. This products gel formula allowed moistuization without leaving me greasy but felt thick enough that I knew my skins barrier was taken care of. It does have a scent to it but its not at all offensive, in fact I think its beautifully scented. It definitely gives spa vibes. The fact that its got an spf of 15 is a plus but ALWAYS apply a separate sunscreen for maximum sun protection. I wore this under makeup everyday, with and without primer and it did not peel or separate. I thouroughly enjoyed using this and plan to purchase a new jar when I run out.

Great moisturizer for my oily but dry skin. It absorbs quickly - not greasy feeling. Wish the SPF was a little higher for everyday use but otherwise it's great! "I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

I used this as my morning moisturizer, and it quickly became an easy daily staple. The texture is creamy but controlled — it absorbs fast, doesn't feel greasy, and layers cleanly under makeup without pilling. My skin felt comfortably hydrated throughout the day, not shiny or tight. The scent is light and fresh, noticeable but not overpowering, and the antioxidant component makes it feel like more than just basic moisture. The SPF 15 works well as a baseline, though I still layer additional sunscreen. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This face cream feels light and refreshing on the skin while providing just the right amount of moisture. It absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy, making it comfortable for everyday wear. I also love that it has SPF built in, so it's an easy all-in-one step for daily hydration and protection. My only complaint is that I wish the SPF were higher for a bit more sun protection. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This cream is lightweight and absorbs easily. It moistens all day long, working great all over my face, including the skin around my eyes. It has a cucumber-like scent and leaves a dewy finish. The jar has a double lid and the packaging is luxurious. I'm taking one star down because I prefer my skincare without colorants or fragrances, and this moisturizer has both. Also, the SPF is too low in my opinion. I always use a 60 SPF lotion after this moisturizer. I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes." I absolutely love the quality and efficacy of Estée Lauder skincare products. I've been using their DayWear Moisturizer Multi-Protection Anti-Oxidant 24H-Moisture Creme SPF 15 for over two weeks straight and it's worked wonders on my skin. I have incorporated it into my morning skincare routine, onto a freshly cleansed face after my serum. A very thin layer does the job and It glides on quite smoothly. It has a beautiful, light texture and it absorbs quickly leaving no oily/greasy feelings left behind. This cream has a nice light and refreshing scent of cucumbers. However, that dissipates a little after being absorbed. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated, nourished, smooth, and slightly plump. I love the fact that it has SPF 15 for daily protection. I'm hoping to see less fine lines with prolonged use. I would definitely recommend getting your hands on this effective moisturizer.

This cream is nice and thick and very moisturizing! It is perfect for cold winter months when you need extra moisture. However the sell gives like a cucumber but it was quite strong for me and I have a sensitive sense of smell not really was a fan of the scent. container is high quality. I also appreciate that it has SPF for daily sun protection. Maybe if there was a different sent to it and it wasn't so strong I would love it but overall it was a nice cream I used it at night and during the day left my face feeling hydrated I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I'm 41 with dry skin and my first fine lines getting deeper. I found DayWear to be very moisturizing and hydrating. My skin looked slightly dewy, but not greasy. It's really thick in the jar, but spreads easily so it doesn't feel like you're wearing 50 layers of goo on your face. 2 negatives for me are the scent and low SPF. There's a kind of cucumber floral smell that is really intense. It doesn't smell bad, per se, but those with fragrance sensitivities should pass on this one. No one applies enough moisturizer to get full sunscreen protection, so the SPF in this is probably more like a 5. Fine if you're staying indoors, but definitely not adequate for anything else. Tldr: I think DayWear Moisturizer is a good moisturizer for people who want a simple but effective anti-aging and hydrating routine. Just watch out if you're sensitive to fragrance, or don't use a separate sunscreen. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes. I really enjoy this moisturizer! It's versatile enough to wear during the day or at night paired with a serum for extra hydration. It does have a scent, but it's light enough to not be noticeable after the initial application. The minor SPF is helpful for those overcast days where you might forget to use your usual SPF. Overall, this is a solid choice for a multifunctional product in your routine.

I used the Estée Lauder DayWear Multi-Protection 24H Moisture cream in the mornings. I liked the texture and the fact that it had a bit of SPF protection which was enough for winter months spent indoors. I did find this cream to be not moisturizing enough for my dry winter skin. I also have the DayWear 72H sorbet which I like a lot better. I will come back to this cream in the summer when my skin feels more naturally hydrated. I also prefer skincare which is fragrance free, which this cream isn't. Overall it's useable, but not my favorite. [I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.]

I was blown away by the Estée Lauder day cream. The consistency is nice and thick and has a cooling feeling when applied. The scent is cucumber like and fees super moisturizing. I love how there is SPF in the cream and doesn't leave a cast on your face. I use after I wash my face. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I've been using the Estée Lauder DayWear Mult Protection Antioxidant 24-Hour Moisturizer and I really like how lightweight it feels on my skin. It keeps my face moisturized all day without feeling heavy or greasy, and it absorbs quickly, which makes it great under makeup. I also like that it has antioxidants and SPF 15 for a little extra daily protection. Overall, it leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and refreshed, and it's a moisturizer I enjoy using every morning.
Have been using it for about 8 weeks now. Love this cream. Moisturizer and sunscreen in 1. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

avis.titre: Love it, must have for winter
avis.texte: I've tried so many moisturizers over the years , but this moisturizer has great hydration, which makes it especially suitable for dry skin. I also love the antioxidant ingredients they have in this one, because they help protect the skin from everyday environmental stress, especially in busy urban areas where the air feels heavier. The texture absorbs quickly, feels non-greasy, and has a light scent. The added SPF 15 is a big plus for me .I like that it includes a little SPF as well, which works nicely under makeup when you work in the office and spending most of the day indoors. Overall, it's a good moisturizer, and I truly enjoy it. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I love using this cream in the morning. Makes my face feel really soft and moisturized, I like how it doesn't make it feel sticky afterward. Having 15spf is a plus for sure. I love the color of the box, and the jar is my favorite. It also has a little bit of a scent, and I like it. "I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

Estée Lauder DayWear Anti-Oxidant 24-Hour Moisturizer SPF 15 has been a great daily moisturizer for my skin. It provides long-lasting hydration without feeling greasy, which is especially important since I live in a cold, dry climate. The cream absorbs quickly, keeps my skin hydrated all day, and wears well under makeup. I also appreciate the light, fresh fragrance which is noticeable but didn't irritate my skin. I do wish the SPF were higher, but overall it's a solid daily moisturizer. I received this product for free from Estée Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This moisturizer felt really nice on my skin. I deal with chronically dry skin and this did help my face feel a little more hydrated . There is a scent to the cream but it isn't overbearing. I wish the SPF was higher but I do appreciate there being some in it . Overall I think it's a great product and fairly priced and worth a try for anyone looking for a new moisturizer to use in their skincare routine . I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. During rhe winter my sKIn IS particularly dry.And this has been helping a. I feel like my skin has been looking more pumped.And the lines have been filled in because of how much hydration this giving me

I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes. This is the perfect AM moisturizer for anyone looking for a healthy radiance. The texture is smooth and absorbs quickly, making it a great base for makeup. Since I started using it, my skin feels hydrated, nourished, and glowing. It really helps with dullness and keeps my face feeling fresh for a full 24 hours. Highly recommend!

Rich consistency of a moisturizer that absorbs nicely into the skin. I will say that SPF 15 doesn't do much so I use a separate sunscreen for skin protection. I have pretty dry skin so I feel like this delivered a nice amount of hydration to my skin. It does make me look a tad bit greasy but that's a given when my skin has never been perfect so I alway have to blot when I use this. Otherwise, I do really like it and it applies well underneath makeup. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I was lucky enough to be selected to try and review Estee Lauder DayWear Moisturizer Multi-Protection Anti-Oxidant 24H‑Moisture Creme SPF 15 and i am so grateful I was chosen! This is the hands down best moisturizer I have ever used! It is made to be a pre makeup moisturizer and it leaves one's skin feeling so smooth and moisturized! The light scent is perfect, I highly recommend trying Estee Lauder's DayWear Moisturizer Multi-Protection Anti-Oxidant 24H‑Moisture Creme SPF 15 and seeing the amazing results for one's self!

As an oily skin women, surprisingly this has been working really well with my skin! I apply it during the morning along with my usual skincare routine. It makes your skin look really nice and firm and I'm so glad it comes with SPF. I also have sensitive skin and it hasn't irritated my skin at all. I would recommend this if you're looking to add this to your collection. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I thought this was just fine. I absolutely hate how strong the fragrance is in this, as it triggers a headache sometimes. I used this in the morning and while it did feel nice and sat pretty well under makeup, it didn't feel super moisturizing. I think it does a fine job, but it's not something I'd reach for over other products as someone with dry skin. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

Very recommended mostariser, I used it for couple weeks applying every morning and i didn't notice any acne appearing this time that is means it doesn't cause any issues on my skin, it is very light and my skin observe it fast ,my skin little bit clear not too much, but it is very hydrated good for dry skin during the winter

avis.titre: Glowy, Lightweight, and Perfect for Morning Skincare!
avis.texte: I used the Estee Lauder DayWear Moisturizer in the morning as part of my skincare routine, and I absolutely loved the results. The cream absorbs quickly and leaves my skin looking fresh and glowy without feeling heavy. The texture is smooth and lightweight, making it perfect under makeup. I also enjoyed the subtle, pleasant scent—it's not overpowering at all. My skin felt hydrated all day, and I appreciated the added SPF 15 for daily protection. Definitely a product I would repurchase! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

Light, creamy, and easy to wear every day. It sinks in quickly, keeps my skin feeling comfortable and hydrated, and sits well under makeup without pilling. I like that it has SPF 15 for a little extra daytime protection, and the scent is subtle and fresh. Overall, a solid everyday moisturizer that makes my skin look healthy and smooth. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I use this moisturizer every morning and I love how light-weight and easy to apply it is. It has a very pleasant scent, but it's not too perfumey. I also love that it has spf in it so it works double duty to protect my skin. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I haven't been overly impressed with Estee Lauder products in the past but I enjoyed this moisturizer. I used it daily in the morning. It's a rich consistency but still absorbs well. It left my skin feeling soft and moisturized. The 15spf is an nice extra but too low to skip actual sunscreen. The one thing I didn't care for was the scent. I've seen the scent described as cucumber but to me it smelled like grass. It didn't linger to me so it wasn't too bad. Overall, I wouldn't replace my current moisturizer, but if I was in a pinch, I would buy this. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I love this moisturizer. Especially the light cucumber smell of it! When I get up in the morning and start my morning routine, the scents hits my nose and it calms me down and I just stand there sniffing on my DayWear Crème., The crème itself is perfect for my combination skin and since it's a little thicker, it's perfect for the cold weather but it's also lightweight enough to use in the summer, especially because of the light cucumber scent. My skin feels amazing and moisturized throughout the day. The light sunscreen of 15 SPF is also enough and can be upgraded with an extra sunscreen if needed. "I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes."

This is a great hydrating moisturizer, somewhat of a hybrid between a lightweight cream and gel. not too heavy but still works great for the cooler winter months. It absorbs quickly, leaving skin feeling plump and refreshed. The product itself is quite heavily scented, so if you're sensitive to scent I'd stay clear. My main gripe with this moisturizer is the SPF. While SPF 15 blocks out 93% of UVB rays, SPF 30 or higher is recommended for avoiding long term sun damage. An extra layer of sunscreen on top of this moisturizer was simply too greasy in my opinion. I wish they had either used a stronger SPF or foregone it entirely. For the price point I would personally not recommend. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I've been using this moisturizer mostly in the morning, and it fits really well into my daily routine. The texture is lightweight but still moisturizing, and it absorbs nicely without feeling greasy or heavy on my skin. My skin feels comfortable and hydrated throughout the day, and it layers well under makeup without pilling. I also appreciate that it contains SPF, which makes it convenient for everyday use. Overall, it's an easy, reliable option for normal to combination skin. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.
